info.title: Infino API
info.description: The Infino hosted data-plane API: per-database table operations — create, ingest, search, and SQL.

post.description: Append rows to a table. The body is an Arrow IPC stream, or a JSON `{"data": [...]}` envelope.

requestBody.description: The rows to append: a JSON `{"data": [...]}` envelope of rows keyed by column name (`application/json`), or an Arrow IPC stream of one record batch (`application/vnd.apache.arrow.stream`).

200.description: Rows appended. Body is an Arrow IPC row stream (application/vnd.apache.arrow.stream), or a JSON `{"data": [...]}` envelope.

403.description: The account already stores one of its limits — rows, or vectors (one per row of a table with a vector column) — so no more can be added. The response body names which limit was reached. Delete rows to free space; reads and deletes are never refused for this reason. Not transient: retrying without freeing space fails identically.

404.description: The target table does not exist. Append never creates a table — create it first with create_table.

409.description: Another write to the same table was in flight, so this one was not applied. A table takes one write at a time. Transient — reissue the identical request after the `Retry-After` interval, or batch more rows per request to need fewer of them.

503.description: The database's workers are still activating, or no capacity is free to place them. Transient — retry after the `Retry-After` interval.

ArrowIpcRows.description:
A raw Arrow IPC stream request body: one record batch of rows, sent as
`Content-Type: application/vnd.apache.arrow.stream`. The most efficient
ingest path — no JSON conversion; the batch's schema must match the
table's.

oneOf.description:
BM25 corpus statistics for idf scoring. Absent ⇒ the engine default
(per-superfile); the engine SDK's remote transport always sends it.

CountRequest.description: `POST /v1/count/{database}`. Count of rows matching a keyword query.

name.description: The database name, unique within the account.

oneOf.description:
Bring-your-own-bucket: where this database's data should live. Omitted
means platform-hosted storage, exactly as before this field existed.

CreateDatabaseResponse.description:
Create-database response. Empty for a platform-hosted database; a bound
one carries what the caller needs to finish the handshake.

oneOf.description: Present when the database was created with a storage binding.
Amazon S3 (or an S3-compatible store via `endpoint`).

endpoint.description: Custom endpoint for an S3-compatible store (https only).

prefix.description:
Root inside the bucket under which everything the platform writes
lives. Omitted roots at the bucket.

requester_pays.description: Whether the bucket has Requester Pays enabled.

role_arn.description:
The customer-owned IAM role the platform will assume
(`arn:aws:iam::<account>:role/<name>`).

oneOf.description:
Google Cloud Storage: the customer grants the platform's service
account an object role on the bucket.

prefix.description: Root inside the bucket. Omitted roots at the bucket.

oneOf.description:
Azure Blob Storage: the customer admin-consents the platform's Entra
application and grants it a data role on the storage account.

prefix.description: Root inside the container. Omitted roots at the container.

CreateDatabaseStorage.description:
A requested storage binding, tagged by provider. Deliberately NOT the
stored [`StorageBinding`] shape: the AWS external id is generated by the
platform during the create call and returned to the caller — accepting one
from the request would let a caller reuse another binding's id and reopen
the confused-deputy hole the id exists to close.

schema.description:
JSON column descriptors. Exactly one of `schema` or `schema_ipc` is
required. Cannot express nested types; use `schema_ipc` for those.

schema_ipc.description:
The table's Arrow schema as a base64-encoded Arrow IPC stream carrying
only the schema message. Exactly one of `schema` or `schema_ipc` is
required. Carries any Arrow type the engine accepts, nested included.

CreatedStorage.description: The binding half of a create response.

external_id.description:
For AWS bindings: the external id to write into the role's trust
policy (`sts:ExternalId` condition). Returned exactly once, here.

verified.description:
Always `false` at create. Call `POST /v1/databases/{name}/storage/verify`
once the grant is in place; workers will not start for this database
until the binding verifies.

DatabaseSummary.description: One database in the account's list, with its lifecycle state.

created_ms.description:
Unix epoch milliseconds when the database was created, or `0` if unknown
(a database registered before creation time was tracked).

name.description: The database name, unique within the account.

state.description:
Lifecycle state: `registered` (usable), `purging` (being deleted), or
`unreachable` (a bound database whose storage grant failed — restore
the grant and re-verify to restore service; the data is not lost).

HybridSearchRequest.description:
`POST /v1/hybrid_search/{database}`. BM25 + vector fused with RRF.
Projection is optional; vector-leg serving is engine-decided.

Metric.description:
Vector distance metric. Accepted case-insensitively, with the aliases
`l2` → `l2sq` and `dot` → `negdot`; serialized canonically.

Mode.description:
Boolean mode for a multi-term FTS query. Accepted case-insensitively on the
wire (`"or"`, `"Or"`, `"OR"`); serialized canonically lowercase.

RowsEnvelope.description:
JSON row envelope for `POST /v1/append/{database}` and
`POST /v1/update/{database}` — the `Content-Type: application/json`
alternative to an Arrow IPC stream body. Rows are JSON objects keyed by
column name, converted server-side into one Arrow batch against the
table's schema.

data.description: Rows as JSON objects keyed by column name.

SchemaField.description: One column in a `create_table` schema. A scalar column is `{name, type}` where `type` is a scalar spelling (`"i32"`, `"large_utf8"`, …); a vector column is `{name, type: "vector", dim}`; a list column is `{name, type: "list", item}`. `dim` is required for `"vector"` and `item` for `"list"`.

dim.description: Fixed length, required for `type: "vector"`. Must be in [1, 4096].

encoding.description:
Response encoding. Omitted (the default) returns the JSON column
descriptors; `"ipc"` returns an Arrow IPC schema message, which is the
only form that can carry a nested column type.

Stats.description:
Which BM25 corpus statistics to score term rarity (idf) with. Accepted
case-insensitively on the wire (`"per_superfile"`, `"global"`); serialized
canonically. Absent on a request ⇒ the engine default (per-superfile).

VectorFilter.description:
Optional text pre-filter for `vector_search`: kNN ranks only among rows
whose FTS-indexed `field_name` matches `query`.

dim.description:
Redundant with the schema column's declared width; the server resolves
the dimension from the schema, so this is optional and, if given, must
agree.

VectorSearchRequest.description:
`POST /v1/vector_search/{database}`. Projection required; `filter` is an
optional pushdown text pre-filter. Probe width and rerank budget are
engine-decided (drain-time calibration) — there are no tuning knobs.
